gates.name: global_timeout
gates.doc: Refuse if the batch's budget is already spent, and set what is left.

gates.name: resolve_target
gates.doc: Resolve the call to a concrete backend, selecting a group member if needed.

gates.name: tool_access
gates.doc: Tool access policy, checked BEFORE starting the server or executing.

gates.name: withdrawal
gates.doc: Tool withdrawal status, checked BEFORE backend invoke (#231).

gates.name: circuit_breaker
gates.doc: Circuit breaker / health degradation of the resolved target.

gates.name: validators
gates.doc: Interceptor validators, fail-closed BEFORE prompting for approval.

gates.name: tenant_budget
gates.doc: Whether the caller's tenant has a budget, and a token for this call (#1445).

gates.name: approval
gates.doc: Human approval gate, plus the re-check of everything it paused.

gates.name: cold_start
gates.doc: Single-flight cold start of the resolved target.

gates.name: deferred_digest_pin
gates.doc: Run the pin check the cold start made possible (#601).
